question: What permanent maximum inbound QQBot gateway event size should OpenClaw support: the proposed 1 MiB ceiling or a larger documented safety margin?
rationale: Enforcing a bound is mechanically correct, but available documentation and proof do not define QQBot's maximum legitimate event size; the value determines whether this remains transparent hardening or can reject valid delivery.

options.title: Require contract-backed limit
options.body: Hold merge until official documentation or representative production evidence supports the chosen ceiling and boundary proof covers it.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Accept 1 MiB as the QQBot channel contract and explicitly own disconnection or delivery risk for larger events.

options.title: Use a larger margin
options.body: Select a larger ceiling such as 16 MiB that still sharply reduces the upstream 100 MiB default while lowering compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Require contract-backed limit
recommendation.body: Hold merge until official documentation or representative production evidence supports the chosen ceiling and boundary proof covers it.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only available history-backed routing candidate connected to a merged analogous gateway payload-bound implementation, though final product authority is not established.
